headline.title: Building trust in the AI era with privacy-led UX
headline.summary: The article discusses the concept of privacy-led user experience (UX), which emphasizes transparency in data collection and usage as a key element of customer relationships. It highlights the potential of this approach in digital marketing, positioning user consent as a foundational aspect of ongoing engagement rather than a mere compliance formality.

articles.title: Meet HoloTab by HCompany. Your AI browser companion.
articles.summary: HCompany has launched HoloTab, an AI-powered browser companion designed to enhance user experience by providing personalized assistance and information while browsing the web. The tool aims to streamline online tasks and improve productivity through its intelligent features.

articles.title: The Deepfake Nudes Crisis in Schools Is Much Worse Than You Thought
articles.summary: An analysis by WIRED and Indicator revealed that nearly 90 schools and 600 students globally have been affected by AI-generated deepfake nude images, highlighting a significant and ongoing crisis. The findings indicate that this issue is worsening and poses serious implications for student safety and privacy.

articles.title: Anthropic’s rise is giving some OpenAI investors second thoughts
articles.summary: Investors are reconsidering their support for OpenAI in light of Anthropic's valuation, which stands at $380 billion. A backer of both companies noted that OpenAI's recent funding round implied a potential IPO valuation of $1.2 trillion or higher, raising concerns about its market position.

articles.title: Turn your best AI prompts into one-click tools in Chrome
articles.summary: A new feature in Chrome allows users to convert their best AI prompts into one-click tools, enhancing accessibility and efficiency. This functionality is demonstrated in a video showcasing its practical applications.

articles.title: Modality-Native Routing in Agent-to-Agent Networks: A Multimodal A2A Protocol Extension
articles.summary: A recent study presents a multimodal Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol extension that enhances task accuracy by 20 percentage points through modality-native routing. The findings indicate that effective cross-modal reasoning relies on the downstream agent's ability to utilize the richer context preserved by this routing method.

articles.title: DeepTest Tool Competition 2026: Benchmarking an LLM-Based Automotive Assistant
articles.summary: The first edition of the Large Language Model Testing competition, part of the DeepTest workshop at ICSE 2026, focused on benchmarking an LLM-based automotive assistant for car manual information retrieval. Four tools were evaluated on their ability to identify user inputs that led to failures in mentioning critical warnings from the manual.

articles.title: The Second Challenge on Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection at NTIRE 2026: Methods and Results
articles.summary: The second Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection (CD-FSOD) Challenge was held at NTIRE 2026 to assess advancements in detecting objects across different domains with minimal annotations. The event garnered significant participation from the research community, highlighting ongoing challenges in this area of object detection and few-shot learning.

articles.title: Fully Homomorphic Encryption on Llama 3 model for privacy preserving LLM inference
articles.summary: The article discusses the implementation of Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) on the Llama 3 model to enhance privacy during large language model (LLM) inference. It highlights the importance of addressing security concerns in generative AI applications across various sectors, including healthcare and finance.

articles.title: Nemotron 3 Super: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
articles.summary: The Nemotron 3 Super is a 120 billion parameter hybrid Mamba-Attention Mixture-of-Experts model that introduces several innovations, including pre-training in NVFP4 and the LatentMoE architecture for improved efficiency. This model is designed to enhance agentic reasoning through optimized accuracy per FLOP and parameter, and incorporates MTP layers for faster inference.

articles.title: Lit2Vec: A Reproducible Workflow for Building a Legally Screened Chemistry Corpus from S2ORC for Downstream Retrieval and Text Mining
articles.summary: The article introduces Lit2Vec, a reproducible workflow designed to create a legally screened chemistry corpus from the Semantic Scholar Open Research Corpus, focusing on metadata-based license screening. The resulting corpus consists of 582,683 full-text research articles, complete with structured text and paragraph-level embeddings for enhanced retrieval and text mining applications.

articles.title: NTIRE 2026 The 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) Challenge: Professional Image Quality Assessment (Track 1)
articles.summary: The NTIRE 2026 challenge introduces the 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) focusing on Professional Image Quality Assessment in Track 1. This initiative addresses the limitations of traditional Image Quality Assessment methods, which often oversimplify complex visual characteristics into single scalar scores, making it difficult to differentiate between high-quality images.
